caption: The image shows a decorative plate with a monochrome design, likely in dark and light tones due to the black and white photograph. The central part of the plate features an architectural scene depicting a building with a tall central spire and classical columns at the entrance, resembling a church or courthouse. There is a horse-drawn carriage in front of the building, and several trees of varying sizes placed around the scene, some closer to the foreground and others in the background. To the left and right of the main building, there are additional structures of different shapes and heights, with some appearing as multi-story buildings. The sky above the buildings includes stylized clouds. Surrounding the central scene, the rim of the plate is decorated with a repeating pattern of flowers and leaves, comprising large blossoms interspersed with leafy vines. The decorative border frames the architectural scene within an ornate floral band.
title: Plate - "Octagon Church, Boston"
